facts.description: Only 2025 completed transaction rows are valid; invalid statuses, record types, forecasts, subtotals, drafts, tests, returns, cancellations, and old-year rows are excluded.
facts.canonical_answer: Use only fiscal_year=2025, status=completed, record_type=transaction rows.
facts.semantic_acceptance: Accept if the final image values imply the correct valid-row scope. The image does not need to list the rule, but values based on forecast, subtotal, cancelled, returned, test, draft, or old-year rows should fail.

facts.description: Net revenue is gross revenue minus discount minus refund.
facts.semantic_acceptance: Accept if the displayed revenue totals match the net-revenue calculation. The formula itself does not need to be printed.

facts.description: Total net revenue for valid 2025 completed transaction rows only.
facts.semantic_acceptance: Accept if the image clearly communicates valid 2025 net revenue as about $1.431M / $1,431,000 after discounts and refunds. Currency punctuation, K/M abbreviation, and minor rounding are acceptable.

facts.description: The highest net-revenue month after valid-row filtering and net-revenue calculation.
facts.canonical_answer: November 2025 is the standout month at about $170,000 net revenue
facts.semantic_acceptance: Accept if November/Nov is identified as the highest or standout month with approximately $170K net revenue.

facts.description: Fastest-growing quarter by quarter-over-quarter net revenue growth.
facts.canonical_answer: Q2 is the quarter where momentum improved fastest, +38.2% / +$91K versus Q1
facts.semantic_acceptance: Accept if Q2 is identified as the fastest quarter-over-quarter improvement versus Q1. The image may use percent growth, dollar change, or clear natural-language wording. Do not accept Q4 merely because Q4 has the highest quarter total.

facts.description: Top three product categories by valid annual net revenue and their share context.
facts.canonical_answer: Top categories by valid net revenue share: Smart Home $428K (29.9%), Audio $387K (27.0%), Accessories $304.5K (21.3%)
facts.semantic_acceptance: Accept if Smart Home, Audio, and Accessories are shown as the top three categories with share-like context. Values may be rounded. Wrong categories, wrong order, or no share context should fail.

facts.description: Optional combined annual net-revenue share of the top three product categories.
facts.canonical_answer: If shown, the top three categories together represent about 78.2% of annual net revenue
facts.semantic_acceptance: Omission is fully acceptable. If a combined top-three share is displayed, accept approximately 78.2%, including reasonable rounding; penalize only an incorrect displayed combined share.

facts.description: Strongest reporting region after mapping each city through region_mapping.json.
facts.source: env/sales_2025.xlsx + env/sales_2025.xlsx City Region Lookup sheet + env/sales_2025.xlsx README sheet
facts.canonical_answer: West is the strongest reporting region, about $597K / 41.7%
facts.semantic_acceptance: Accept if West is identified as the strongest/top reporting region after applying the city-to-reporting-region mapping. Dollars, share, or a clear leader callout are acceptable.

facts.description: A concise insight explaining the main trend in the computed results.
expected_value: Q2 had the sharpest QoQ lift, while November marked the annual peak.
Momentum improved fastest in Q2, with November as the year's highest month.
Q2 was the fastest-growing quarter and November was the peak month.
facts.canonical_answer: Trend insight notes fastest momentum in Q2 and/or November as the annual peak
facts.semantic_acceptance: Accept any concise, data-grounded trend sentence that correctly interprets the computed results, especially Q2 momentum and November peak. Do not require sample wording.

facts.description: Do not use unit, order-count, gross, forecast, subtotal, draft, old-year, cancelled, returned, pending, manual-review, adjustment, rollup, snapshot, or test-row values as final answers.
expected_value: wrong metric or distractor used as final answer
facts.canonical_answer: Do not present invalid metrics or distractor rows as final answers
facts.semantic_acceptance: Strictly reject or cap if units/order count/gross revenue/forecast/subtotal/draft/old-year/cancelled/returned/pending/manual-review/adjustment/rollup/snapshot/test data are used as final sales results. Benign mentions that these rows were excluded are allowed.

calculation_notes: Use only rows where fiscal_year=2025, status=completed, and record_type=transaction. Compute net revenue per row as gross_revenue - discount - refund. Exclude cancelled, returned, pending, manual_review, internal_test, adjustment, forecast, subtotal, rollup, snapshot, draft, and 2024 rows. Valid net revenue totals: annual=$1,431,000; monthly high is November=$170,000. Quarter totals are Q1=$238,000, Q2=$329,000, Q3=$388,500, Q4=$475,500, so QoQ growth is Q2=38.2%, Q3=18.1%, Q4=22.4%; fastest is Q2 over Q1. Category totals and shares of annual net revenue: Smart Home=$428,000 (29.9%), Audio=$387,000 (27.0%), Accessories=$304,500 (21.3%), Outdoor Tech=$178,000 (12.4%), Services=$133,500 (9.3%). City mapping produces reporting-region totals: West=$597,000 (41.7%), Northeast=$387,000 (27.0%), Central=$299,500 (20.9%), Southeast=$86,500 (6.0%), South Central=$61,000 (4.3%).
